architecture:
# Android architecture — Playback core + Now Playing

## 0. Where Android stands (grounded)
`PlaybackController` (652 lines) is a *facade over ExoPlayer's playlist*: ▶ resolves one song (manifest → AM full-track → AM preview → rip-on-demand → metadata-only), builds `MediaItem`s with `PlaybackContract` extras (URL, clip window, history context, album id, isLive/isPreview) and calls `setMediaItems`. `PlaybackService` (`MediaSessionService`, same process — **never add `android:process`**) rebuilds URI + `ClippingConfiguration` in `onAddMediaItems` and is the single History emitter (`onMediaItemTransition` id-gate → `PlayEventBus`). `QueuePlan` resolves a setlist at build time (skips RipRequired rows, duplicates items for repeatCount). `AppleMusicBackend` is a second engine with no MediaSession. Jukebox writes into the `MediaController` playlist directly. There is no sequencer object, no Now Playing deck, no durable session, no dead-air/stall discipline, no diag upload.

iOS's playback core is a 2.6k-line **index-cursor sequencer** (`SetlistPlayer`) that resolves each row **fresh at its turn**, owns every live-queue edit, and carries ~30 hard-won invariants (listed in the inventory). The port keeps those semantics and uses Media3 where it genuinely helps.

## 1. Core decision: sequencer owns the queue; ExoPlayer holds a 1–2 item window
`playback/sequencer/SetlistSequencer` (app-scoped singleton in `AppGraph`, `@MainThread` state, `StateFlow<SequencerState>`) is the Android `SetlistPlayer`. It owns `queue: List<QueueItem>` (`id`, `title`, `artist`, `lengthMs?`, `repeatCount?`, `variant?`, `editionLocked`, `uid: String = UUID`), `index`, `isRunning`, `isHeldForResume`, `sourceSetlistId`, `capturedContext: PlayContext`, `capturedOrigin`, `repeatMode`, `shuffleEnabled` (+ `canonicalOrder`), `waitingForLive`, `pausedByCascade`, `playbackNotice`, `playGeneration`.

ExoPlayer's playlist is **not** the queue. The sequencer loads **the current row** (and, after PB-10, pre-loads the *next resolved* row for gapless local/rip→rip boundaries) through the `MediaController`; `MEDIA_ITEM_TRANSITION_REASON_AUTO` / `STATE_ENDED` / `onPlayerError` are reported back as `handleEnded` / `handleFailed`. Why not keep the whole playlist in ExoPlayer: Apple Music rows play on a separate engine, rows must be resolved fresh (a rip may land between build and play), repeatCount/repeat-one/dead-source/hop/cascade/live-HLS semantics all need the cursor in app code, and live edits address rows by `uid`, which Media3 items lack.

Row start (`startPlayCurrent(fresh, resumeAtMs)` — the ONLY spawn funnel): cancel the previous `playJob`, `if (!isActive) return`, claim `++playGeneration`, `endMixEngagement()` if fresh, arm `currentPlaysRemaining = normalizedRepeat(repeatCount)` if fresh, then `RowSourceResolver.resolve(item, mode)`:
1. `LocalFileResolver.localUrlForPlayback(id, decision)` (seam; default null until the burn store lands) → `MediaItem(file://…, clip startMs/startMs+lengthMs)`;
2. `RipsRepository.entry(id)` → `PlayAction.Stream` (public mp3 + clip window; instant);
3. Apple Music full-track when `song.appleMusicId != null && appleMusicBackend.canPlayFullTrack()` AND (song is AM-sourced OR the rip is not instant — iOS `ripStartsNow` rule);
4. rip-on-demand (`RipRequired`, server configured): `MediaItem(pdj-resolve://song/<id>)` — resolved lazily by a `ResolvingDataSource` inside the service (POST /rip → `streamUrl` live HLS if present, else `awaitReady` ≤30 min) while the row is already current (card shows it, state BUFFERING, FGS alive);
5. none → `advanceToNext(UNPLAYABLE_HERE)`.
**No 30 s preview rung inside a run** (a preview would advance the set every 30 s); the single-row ▶ keeps it. After an `await`, guard `isActive && gen == playGeneration` before touching any state (the stems-toggle discipline: commit only at your own generation).

Threading: sequencer state mutations on `Dispatchers.Main.immediate`; resolution I/O in `scope.launch` jobs tied to `playGeneration`; `MediaController` calls hop to Main (existing `withController`). ExoPlayer runs on its own playback thread; we only read `Player` state on Main.

## 2. Packages (new, under `android/app/src/main/java/com/levi/pocketdj/`)
- `playback/sequencer/` — `SetlistSequencer`, `QueueItem`, `SequencerState`, `RowSourceResolver`, `LocalFileResolver` (interface), `EditionDecider` (interface, default unchanged), `AdvanceCause`.
- `playback/session/` — `SequencerForwardingPlayer` (wraps ExoPlayer for the `MediaSession`), `AppleMusicPlayerAdapter : SimpleBasePlayer`, `SessionSwitchboard` (which `Player` the session shows), `FavoriteCommand` seam, `ResolvingSongDataSource`.
- `playback/health/` — `PlaybackRunway`, `StartWatchdog`, `ResolveStallHop`, `AutoAdvanceCascadeBreaker`, `PlaybackRipWindow`, `PlaybackSupervisor` (Core + Shell), `DeadAirMeter`, `LiveBackstop`.
- `playback/durable/` — `PlaybackSessionStore`, `SessionSnapshot` (JSON models).
- `playback/outcome/` — `SkipTracker`.
- `diag/` — `DiagLog`, `NPLog`, `SigV4`, `DiagCredentialStore`.
- `screens/nowplaying/` — `NowPlayingScreen`, `NowPlayingDeckCluster`, `RecordPlayer`, `UpNextList`, `PlayedList`, `NowPlayingSearch`, `NowPlayingViewModel`.

Shared touch points (named so packages stay disjoint): `di/AppGraph.kt` (one `val sequencer`, `val sessionStore`, `val diag`, `val skipTracker` each — add lines, never restructure), `MainActivity.kt` (one `composable(NOW_PLAYING_ROUTE)` + MiniPlayerBar `onTap`), `playback/PlaybackContract.kt` (new extra keys appended), `playback/PlayEvents.kt` (`PlayStarted.originCollectionId`), `data/settings/AppSettingsStore.kt` (keys `playbackMode`, `diagKey*`, `telemetryEnabled`), `data/rips/RipServerClient.kt` (`cancelRips(ids)`), `data/collections/CollectionsStore.kt` (`materializeNowPlayingSetlist`), `data/jukebox/JukeboxRepository.kt` (route inserts through the sequencer), `screens/settings/SettingsScreen.kt` (Debug section), `screens/history/HistoryRows.kt` (outcome glyph + live row).

## 3. Lock-screen / notification / remote transport
`PlaybackService` builds `SequencerForwardingPlayer(exoPlayer)` and gives THAT to `MediaSession`. Overrides: `seekToNext/seekToNextMediaItem → sequencer.skipNext()`, `seekToPrevious* → sequencer.skipPrevious()` (never below 0; repeat-all wraps), `setRepeatMode → sequencer.setRepeatMode(map)`, `setShuffleModeEnabled → sequencer.setShuffle(on)`, `play()` when `mediaItemCount == 0 || playbackState == IDLE` → `sequencer.onIdlePlay()` ladder (`resumeHeld` / `startCurrent` / `startInFlight` ignore) else latch `pendingRemotePlayAt` (15 s, consumed by a later restore); `getAvailableCommands` advertises next/prev/repeat/shuffle only while `sequencer.isRunning`; `play()` on a BUFFERING item = re-kick (`prepare()`), never a pause. Each remote command logs `[transport] rc cmd=… owner=… verdict=…`. The ♥ is a `CommandButton` with `SessionCommand("pdj.favorite")` whose handler calls a `FavoriteToggleSeam` (null → button hidden) — wired by the activity-favorites area. Media3 publishes the notification + lock-screen card from the session player; the "honest card" is native (BUFFERING with playWhenReady shows ⏸ and no moving cursor). `announceUpcoming` = loading the new row's `MediaItem` with full `MediaMetadata` + artwork URI immediately (its URI may be `pdj-resolve://`).

Apple Music rows: `AppleMusicPlayerAdapter : SimpleBasePlayer` maps `MediaPlayerController` state/position/duration/commands into a Media3 `Player`; `SessionSwitchboard` calls `mediaSession.setPlayer(forwardingPlayer or amAdapter)` when the sequencer's active backend flips, so the lock screen always shows exactly ONE card (iOS "impersonate" rule) and ⏭/⏮ still reach the sequencer (the adapter's seekToNext/Previous delegate the same way). `onItemEnded` → `handleAppleMusicEnded(NATURAL)`; the ported pure `endReason(...)` decides SYSTEM_SKIP (paused at ≤1 s after ≥2 s progress, not intentionalPause) and NEVER_STARTED (12 s without PLAYING) from the SDK's state callbacks + a 400 ms position poll; `onPlaybackError` mid-run → dead-source advance. Device-only to verify; the adapter is unit-tested against a fake controller interface.

## 4. Zero dead air (the iOS 2026-10 program, Android mapping)
- **Runway**: `PlaybackRunway(name)` = `PowerManager` partial WakeLock (25 s cap, idempotent end, `[runway] begin/end held=…s reason=…`) held from `startPlayCurrent` until first audio. The service stays foreground while `sequencer.isRunning` (the current row is loaded with `playWhenReady=true`, so Media3 keeps the FGS; `setForegroundServiceTimeoutMs` if the Media3 1.6.1 API exists, else keep the item BUFFERING).
- **First audio** = `onIsPlayingChanged(true)` with `playbackState == READY` (local lane) or AM `PLAYING` → `DeadAirMeter.firstAudio()`, close the start window, cancel the start watchdog. Log `[playback] start-ok song=… after=…ms`.
- **Start watchdog**: 8 s no audio (and not `pausedByListener`) → `[playback] start-stall …` + `prepare()` re-kick; 20 s → `escalateStalledStart` (hop else `advanceToNext(AUTO)`).
- **Resolve-stall hop** (6 s inside the `pdj-resolve://` wait): move the first on-device row (else first instant-start row: manifest hit / AM-ready) within 50 ahead to `index`, defer the stalled row behind it (never dropped), `[playback] resolve stalled 6s song=… → hop to on-device …`.
- **Pause discrimination** (for watchdog/supervisor "never fight the listener"): `pausedByListener` = `playWhenReady` false with reason `USER_REQUEST`/`REMOTE`/`AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY` (route loss = listener pause); `interruptionOpen` = `playbackSuppressionReason == TRANSIENT_AUDIO_FOCUS_LOSS` or reason `AUDIO_FOCUS_LOSS`. ExoPlayer resumes after transient focus loss itself (iOS P0-4 behaviour); a focus loss while the listener had paused never un-pauses.
- **Cascade breaker** + **rip window** + **live backstop**: pure ports (`AutoAdvanceCascadeBreaker.shouldHalt(afterAudibleSeconds)`, `PlaybackRipWindow.windowIds/evict/endSession`, 45 s grace after length). `trackAudibleSeconds` sampled by the 1 Hz ticker (audible = isPlaying && position advanced ≥100 ms).
- **Supervisor**: `PlaybackSupervisor.Core.step(probe, now)` ported verbatim (L1 3 s rekick, L2 +12 s retryInPlace ≤2/song, L3 +8 s escalate; detector-only while startPending/trackEnded/AM lane; engaged only when intentPlaying && !userPaused && !held && !interruptionOpen && !cascadeHalted). Shell ticks 1 Hz from the sequencer's ticker; `meter.accumulate` + `transitionAbandoned`.
- **DeadAirMeter**: same `Document{days:{"YYYY-MM-DD": Day}}` JSON at `filesDir/pocketdj-dead-air.json`, 60-day prune, 30 s save throttle, `[deadair] gap=%.2fs from=… to=… cause=…` and the day summary line **character-identical** to iOS so `scripts/deadair-report.py` works unchanged on `android-<id8>` logs. Backend names: `burned`, `presigned`→`rip`, `hls`, `appleMusic`, `none`.
- **Gapless (PB-10)**: once the current row is READY, pre-resolve the next row; if it is a local/manifest item, `addMediaItem` it as a 2nd window item so Media3 preloads and auto-transitions (`burned→burned ≈ 0 s`). Live edits that change `queue[index+1]` replace window slot 1. AM/rip-required next rows are not pre-added. `handleEnded` reconciles ExoPlayer's AUTO transition with `index += 1` (or seeks back to clip start for repeat-one/repeatCount>1 instead of adding).

## 5. Durable session
`PlaybackSessionStore` writes `filesDir/pocketdj-playback-session.json` with the iOS `Snapshot` shape (schemaVersion 1; `sessionId "pses_<uuid>"`; `source{kind,id,name,originKind,originId}`; `queue[{songId,title,artist,lengthMs,repeatCount,variant,editionLocked}]`; `index`; `positionMs` song-relative; `isPlaying`; `repeatMode "off|all|one"`; `shuffleEnabled`; `stemLock` opaque JsonObject; `updatedAt` epoch-ms double). Writer = single `Channel`-fed coroutine with a monotonic version (stale writes and the `clear()` delete can never resurrect a cleared session); encode off-main; atomic temp+rename. Triggers: `play` (pos 0), every index move (pos 0), every live edit, pause/resume immediately, 1 Hz ticker throttled to 5 s. `restoreIfIdle()` runs from `AppGraph` init (before catalog load): rebuild queue with fresh uids, `isHeldForResume=true`, NO audio, NO session card (`mediaSession.player` stays idle), NO file write; honour a pending remote play ≤15 s old. First ▶ → `resumeFromHold()` → `startPlayCurrent(fresh=false, resumeAtMs)` (local: clip start + resumeMs seek; AM: play then seek). Any skip/jump → `exitHoldIfNeeded()`. `ProcessLifecycleOwner` ON_STOP → `flushSessionSnapshotNow()` + `DeadAirMeter.flush()` + `skipTracker.checkpoint()`.

## 6. History outcomes
`PlayEvent` gains additive-optional `originInstallId`, `wasSkipped`, `listenedFraction`, `tzOffsetMin`, `originCollectionId` (same JSON keys as iOS; `carPlay`/`listeningContext` left absent). `PlayHistoryStore.record` stamps `tzOffsetMin` + `originInstallId` + `originCollectionId` (from `PlayStarted.originCollectionId`, set by the sequencer when `contextId == set_now_playing`), fires `onRecord(event)`; the 30 s window hit fires `onResume(existingEvent)`. `markSkipped(eventId)`, `noteListened(eventId, fraction)` max-merge. `SkipTracker` port: `noteTrackStarted/Resumed/Restarted`, `samplePosition` 1 Hz from the sequencer ticker, `noteAdvanceAway(songId, positionMs?, durationMs?)` on skipNext / jump / playNow / fresh play over a run / AM systemSkip (NEVER natural end, repeat, dead-source, ⏮, stop, live 'Next'); strict `< 0.5`; one-deep previous stash; `checkpoint()`. History rows render outcome (skipped/completed/partial) and the live row keyed by `skipTracker.currentEventId`.

## 7. Now Playing UI (Compose)
Route `nowplaying` pushed by MiniPlayerBar tap and by every ▶/🔀 funnel that today navigates to `setlistRoute(NOW_PLAYING_SETLIST_ID, autoplay)` (SetlistDetailScreen keeps serving REAL setlists). `NowPlayingViewModel` exposes `sequencer.state` + a 1 Hz `progress` poll (no hot position flow). Deck cluster: title/artist (`np-title/np-artist` test tags mirrored as Compose `testTag`s), `RecordPlayer` (Canvas; gold platter, accent chassis; `revsPerSecond = clamp(bpm/4, 8, 120)/60` else 33⅓ RPM; `withFrameNanos` angle accumulator frozen in place on pause; spins only when the audible track is the deck's row; tonearm outer-edge→center by progress, 1 Hz), transport ⏮⏯⏭ routed through `NowPlayingTransport.togglePlayPause` (held → resumeFromHold; cascade → startCurrent; AM backend → AM toggle; idle engine + start pending → ignore + log; idle → startCurrent; else toggle), ⟲ played toggle, ♥ (seam), 👍/👎 (seam, hidden when no RecFeedbackStore), shuffle/repeat row (only while running; repeat glyph `repeat`/`repeat_one`; help strings off/session/song), notice banner `np-playback-notice`, long-press record → `SongDetailSheet`. Up Next: `LazyColumn` over `upcoming` (windowed 200), drag reorder via `moveUpcoming(fromOffsets, toOffset)` clamped, swipe/✕ → `removeUpcoming(uids)`, DropdownMenu Play now / Play next / Move to end / Remove / Song detail; Played list with Rewind to here (`jumpToPlayed`) / Play now (`playNow(fresh QueueItem)`); add-search (`SearchBar`, 200 ms debounce, `Dispatchers.Default` over catalog snapshots, albums above songs, collapsible, `insertNextInQueue` / `appendToQueue`); header "Open set list" → `collections.materializeNowPlayingSetlist(name, rows)` → `setlistRoute`. Landscape/tablet: `NowPlayingExpandedLayout` with played/up-next flanks (no resize grabber). MiniPlayerBar: title, ⏮⏯⏭, expand chevron, Preparing… row; hidden while a Mix session owns audio (seam `mixSessionActive`, default false).

## 8. Diag logging
`DiagLog` (process singleton): `log(category, message)` (facts only), `telemetry(category, message)` (titles allowed, opt-in), ring buffer, parts of 500 lines, 40k session cap, flush 15 s (3 s telemetry) / immediate on `error` / 25 pending, serialized uploads (latest body per key), `UploadStatus` (channelEnabled, keyPresent, lastSuccessAt, lastError) persisted in DataStore, `[diag] status` at launch, outcome transitions logged, buffered-until-key. Key: `diag/android-<installId first 8>/<ISO stamp>-b<versionCode>[-pN].log` in bucket `pocketdj-logs-623170744161` (from `RemoteEndpoints` so an account move needs no release), region us-west-2, hand-rolled SigV4 PUT over OkHttp. Channel gate: `BuildConfig.DEBUG || settings.diagEnabled`. `NPLog.trace(msg)` → `Log.d("PocketDJ.np")` + mirrored `[np]` line. Settings ▸ Debug: diag key field, Remote diagnostics toggle, Remote telemetry toggle, status readout, "Playback dead air" readout (today's `DeadAirMeter.summaryLine`), "Capture log" share.

## 9. Mix DSP engine
Not decided here. This area touches Mix only through the F4 mini-panel / Stem Lock hand-off; it defines `NowPlayingDspSeam` (`engage(file, startMs, lengthMs, atSeconds, play)`, `disengage()`, `isPlaying`, `currentTimeSec`, `rate`, `onReachedEnd`) and the `mixSessionActive` gate so either an Oboe/native or an AudioTrack engine can plug in without touching the sequencer. Recommendation for the Mix area: any hand-off engine must honour the one-audio-owner rule by publishing through the same `SessionSwitchboard` (a `SimpleBasePlayer` adapter), never a second `MediaSession`.

## 10. Verification strategy
JVM: sequencer semantics with a `FakePlayerPort` (interface over the MediaController calls: setItem/prepare/play/pause/seek/stop + listener), virtual-time (`runTest`) for watchdogs/hops/backstops, table-driven Supervisor/CascadeBreaker/RipWindow/DeadAirMeter/SkipTracker/endReason, JSON round-trips against iOS fixture snapshots copied verbatim. Emulator (AVD `pocketdj`): real rip URLs from the public manifest, `adb shell dumpsys media_session` for the card/commands, `adb shell cmd media_session dispatch` (next/prev/play/pause) for remote transport, `am kill` + relaunch for held restore, airplane-mode toggles for stall/hop/cascade, `logcat -s PocketDJ.np PocketDJ.diag`. Device-only: Apple Music full-track rows, the AM session card, Bluetooth route loss, Android Auto.
decisions: Sequencer owns the queue (index cursor + per-row uid); ExoPlayer holds only the current row (plus one pre-resolved next row after PB-10). Never hand the whole setlist to ExoPlayer's playlist again — AM rows, fresh per-row resolve, repeatCount, dead-source/hop/cascade and uid-addressed live edits all need the cursor in app code.

MediaSession is driven by a SequencerForwardingPlayer; ⏭/⏮/repeat/shuffle/idle-play are intercepted there (the iOS onNext/onPrevious/onRepeatModeChange/onIdlePlay hooks). The service and the sequencer share one process — `android:process` must never be set.

One system card always: when the Apple Music engine owns audio, the session's Player is swapped to an AppleMusicPlayerAdapter (SimpleBasePlayer) via MediaSession.setPlayer — the Android form of iOS 'impersonate'. No second MediaSession ever.

Cloud rows that need async work (rip-on-demand) load as `pdj-resolve://song/<id>` MediaItems resolved by a ResolvingDataSource inside the service: the row is current immediately (instant metadata = iOS announceUpcoming), the card is honestly BUFFERING, and the foreground service stays alive through the resolve (the runway). Sync-available rows (local/manifest) keep the existing extras-based URL rebuild.
No 30-second preview rung inside a sequencer run (it would advance the set every 30 s); previews stay a single-row ▶ fallback.

Android never fires passive stream-through rips (no catalog-owner identity; specs/playback.md §3). Rip-on-demand inside a run is explicit per-row, gated by the rip-ahead window (playing + next 10) with /rip-cancel on eviction.

Durable session JSON is shape-identical to iOS `PlaybackSessionStore.Snapshot` (schemaVersion 1); restore is held (no audio, no card) and is NOT a write — the file's mtime must mean 'last actually played here' for the future S3 profile sync.
History outcome fields reuse the iOS JSON keys (wasSkipped, listenedFraction, tzOffsetMin, originCollectionId, originInstallId); `carPlay`/`listeningContext` are left absent, never renamed.
DeadAirMeter document shape and every `[deadair]`/`[supervisor]`/`[playback]` log line keep the iOS grammar so scripts/deadair-report.py works on `android-<id8>` logs without changes.
Diag upload uses a hand-rolled SigV4 PUT over OkHttp (no AWS SDK dependency); channel gate = debuggable build or an explicit Settings toggle, since Android has no TestFlight receipt.

Pause discrimination comes from Media3 playWhenReady change reasons + playbackSuppressionReason, not from timing heuristics: USER_REQUEST/REMOTE/AUDIO_BECOMING_NOISY = listener pause; AUDIO_FOCUS_LOSS / TRANSIENT suppression = interruption. The supervisor and watchdogs never act on a listener pause.

Edition (clean/explicit) fields are reserved on QueueItem and the session Row for JSON compatibility with an EditionDecider seam defaulting to 'unchanged'; the explicit system itself belongs to the browse/collections area.

F4 Mix mini-panel + Stem Lock are deferred to the Mix area behind a NowPlayingDspSeam; the Mix DSP engine choice is not made here, but any hand-off engine must publish through the same SessionSwitchboard (one audio owner, one card).
